description: v0.3.1 — Isolate cursor-trellis runtime directory: .trellis/ -> .cstl/ for coexistence with upstream Trellis in the same repo.
changelog:
**@blxzer/cursor-trellis 0.3.1**

### Breaking
- feat(runtime): cursor-trellis project runtime moves from `.trellis/` to **`.cstl/`** so upstream [mindfold-ai/Trellis](https://github.com/mindfold-ai/Trellis) can keep `.trellis/` in the same repository.
- feat(agents): AGENTS.md managed block uses `<!-- CSTL:START -->` markers (legacy `TRELLIS:START` upgraded on migrate).
- chore(channel): `cstl channel` multi-agent CLI is **not registered** (Cursor-only product scope).

### Upgrade

```bash
npm install -g @blxzer/cursor-trellis@0.3.1
cd /path/to/project
cstl update --migrate
```

`--migrate` is **required**. History (tasks/archive, workspace, spec, local/cursor2plus) is preserved via directory rename, not delete-recreate.
aiInstructions:
When helping migrate to 0.3.1:
1. Run `npm install -g @blxzer/cursor-trellis@0.3.1` then `cstl update --migrate` in each cursor-trellis project.
2. The migration renames `.trellis/` -> `.cstl/` when cursor-trellis ownership is detected; aborts if upstream-only Trellis is detected without cstl fingerprints.
3. Update script paths: `python ./.cstl/scripts/...` (not `./.trellis/scripts/`).
4. AGENTS.md: user content preserved; managed block becomes `CSTL:START/END`.
5. Upstream `.trellis/` in the same repo (other agents) is left untouched when only adding `.cstl/` via fresh init; rename migrate only applies to cursor-trellis-owned trees.
